Fieldwork

Your next user interview is down the street.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R takes you out of the studio and into your own neighbourhood to study real problems alongside the community, with a mentor checking every step. The users, it turns out, have addresses.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork Want research on your portfolio that hiring managers can check? FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship where school and university students study real problems in their own neighbourhood with the community, and every piece of work is verified. earth5r.org/fieldwork
